# joint spatial/player accounting

units: squared attempts per 60 team minutes. entries are mean [0.025, 0.975] paired whole-record intervals. `E` is error energy, `S` is known deployment-signal energy and `I` is signed context coupling. for test/rest rows `delta = E-S+I`; cross rows retain `E_cross-S_cross`, with no separate coupling. a band total is the complete sum of its two player partitions and signed cross term.

test means the thirty scored disjoint pair contrasts. rest includes common effects, untested combinations and unsupported directions; it is not synonymous with unidentifiable effects. the player partitions are euclidean-orthogonal, not deployment-orthogonal, so their cross terms need not vanish. spatial bands are orthogonal under the checked inverse-reference-share metric. omitted fitted correction is zero: its error equals signal and its coupling/excess cancel, while omitted context may still contribute absolute risk.
